description.value: A scheduled shuttle along the 55 km Galloping Goose Trail, linking Victoria, Metchosin and Sooke. Three stops, roughly 20 km apart: Atkins Road Park & Ride near Thetis Lake (km 10), the Rocky Point Road lot near Matheson Lake (km 30), and Sooke Regional Potholes parking lot 3 (km 50). The route is driven multiple times a day in both directions, with set stop times. A one-way shuttle pass is $19 per person and you bring your own bike, with no extra charge for the bike. E-bike rental packages that include the shuttle run $119 to $129 per person. Every ride must be booked in advance and seats may be limited, so arrive 15 minutes early. Pets are welcome as a paid add-on. Runs April to October.

Bike fee applies.detail: The $19 one-way pass is the fare; no surcharge for your bike
